data.notes: As of 2026-10-13, February 2027 underground Bangkok listings are still sparse; searches across RA, DICE, Shotgun, Eventbrite, Bangkok Nights/Bangkok Venues and venue/promoter pages surfaced only one verifiable non-mainstream club event.

events.title: Maroon 5 Asia 2027 in Bangkok
events.summary: Maroon 5 bring their Asia 2027 tour to IMPACT Arena in Bangkok, promoted by Live Nation Tero. The official event page lists Maroon 5 as the headliner for 9 February 2027.

events.title: Freya Skye - Stars Align Tour in Bangkok
events.summary: Freya Skye plays her first headline Bangkok show on the Stars Align Tour at Samyan Mitrtown Hall. Ticketmaster Thailand lists the event for 12 February 2027 at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Not Normal: Balinsky, DOTT, Topper
events.summary: Not Normal brings Balinsky, DOTT and Topper to Elsewhere Bangkok on Saturday 27 February 2027. The venue page confirms the date, lineup and 11:30 PM start time.

events.title: Elaheh, Kunanon, CRL at Elsewhere Bangkok
events.summary: Elsewhere Bangkok confirms a Friday-night bill with Elaheh, Kunanon and CRL on 19 February 2027. The event is listed as starting at 11:30 PM at the Silom venue.

events.title: Young Sun, JIRUS at Elsewhere Bangkok
events.summary: Young Sun and JIRUS are listed for Elsewhere Bangkok on Saturday 20 February 2027. The venue’s event page gives an 11:30 PM start time.

events.title: SESSION
events.summary: After-hours underground session at Elsewhere in Silom with SESSION 4000 and JIRUS; listed as acid house, ambient, electro, electro techno, minimal house, tech house and techno, with 400 THB entry.

events.title: Biliguudei at Elsewhere Bangkok
events.summary: Elsewhere Bangkok lists Biliguudei for Friday 26 February 2027. The club event is scheduled from 11:30 PM at Elsewhere Bangkok on Silom 5.

events.title: KWH at Elsewhere Bangkok
events.summary: Elsewhere Bangkok lists KWH for a late-night club event on Friday 5 February 2027. The venue page states the event starts at 11:30 PM at 425 Silom 5.
